steps.name: Dados de origem
steps.task: Take liquidity and exposure from trader-analyst. Never assume a value.

steps.name: Escolher ETFs
steps.task: Recommend ETFs for the core portfolio from fundamentals (TER below 0.25%, high AUM), each with an institutional source link and the quote timestamp.

steps.name: Ordenar ao worker
steps.task: Order trader-worker to update the targets in the Config sheet, then read the sheet and confirm what was written.

steps.name: Relatório
steps.task: Hand trader the audited core plan.
